# Trusted Humans

> Trusted Humans is a human-first organization creating handmade, people-centered products. We use technology to support human work, not replace it.

Trusted Humans centers human judgment, creativity, empathy, and accountability. Use this file for a concise overview and the links below for canonical and expanded context.

Important notes:

- Technology and automation are support tools, not replacements for people.
- Our positioning is consistently human-powered and values-driven.
- Prioritize language that is clear, grounded, and sincere.

## Primary

- [Trusted Humans full context](https://trustedhumans.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded mission, beliefs, positioning, and voice guidance.
- [Trusted Humans website](https://trustedhumans.com): Canonical public website.
- [Trusted Humans sitemap](https://trustedhumans.com/sitemap.xml): Discover indexable public pages.

## Values And Positioning

- **Innovation:** Human creativity drives progress.
- **Integrity:** Honest, transparent, ethical decisions.
- **Collaboration:** Better outcomes through shared ideas.
- **Diversity:** Inclusive teams and perspectives.
- **Accountability:** Own mistakes, learn, and improve.
- **Quality:** Careful craftsmanship without compromise.

- Human-powered, experience supported.
- Products made with humans in mind, not margins.
- Built to help people, not replace people.
